claim_boundary: This preregistered development campaign consumes the already-observed source-v4 public plan, unqualified development reader, theta0 v2, and the one completed forced common-batch artifact. It executes exactly 112 synthetic roots, three frozen arms, and forty evaluation decisions per arm. Collection decisions zero through seven are excluded from every effect estimand. Learnable is full minus frozen_theta0; Steerable is frozen_theta0 minus strict_noop. All three arms generate PE-derived credit during evaluation but never apply it to the gate. Root is the analysis and bootstrap unit. The fixed practical floor, paired whole-root bootstrap, simultaneous primary and safety bounds, durability rule, and legal failure statuses are frozen before execution. Rehearsal, model invocation, CUDA, public Gist anchoring, partial resume, complete-case filtering, and optional stopping are outside this protocol. Any GO only authorizes design of a new power/preregistration protocol. The source texts are transductively observed, the reader is unqualified, virtual gaps are not real elapsed companionship, roots are synthetic rather than people, and typed executor actuation is not residual or physical actuation. Therefore this campaign cannot establish Appendable, Readable, Learnable, Steerable, their conjunction, unseen or formal evidence, human validity, production ACTIVE, or thesis completion.
